article.title: AdTonos更名為Turms，把車內廣告列為早期重點
article.summary: 程式化音訊廣告公司AdTonos更名為Turms，公布以車內等使用情境為重點的Movement Media構想。
highlights: 聯網車輛是早期重點，構想亦涵蓋數位戶外、零售媒體和聯網電視。
擬以情境訊號協助選擇投放時機的AI工具仍在開發，原有音訊業務繼續。
article.why: 規劃車內或跨渠道廣告時，採購團隊可以先釐清可投放的時段、裝置和成效衡量方式。
article.next_step: 索取現有車款、地區、版位及衡量方法清單，再決定是否納入媒體採購規劃。
article.detail: 據PPC Land報道，Turms計劃讓開發中的Movement Media AI評估活動目標、獲准使用的情境訊號、庫存及表現資料，再建議是否適合投放。公布內容未列出現時可採購的跨渠道版位，以及哪些訊號會在車內實際使用。公司表示會繼續為既有音訊客戶及合作夥伴提供支援。
article.title_en: AdTonos rebrands as Turms and makes in-car ads an early priority
article.summary_en: Programmatic audio business AdTonos renamed itself Turms and set out a Movement Media strategy for contexts including connected cars.
highlights_en: Connected vehicles are an early priority. The plan also includes digital out-of-home, retail media and connected TV.
Its AI for choosing when and where ads might run is in development. The existing audio business continues.
article.why_en: Media buyers can clarify eligible times, devices and measurement before planning in-car or cross-channel purchases.
article.next_step_en: Ask for current vehicle, market, placement and measurement lists before putting the option into a media buying plan.
article.detail_en: PPC Land reports that Turms intends its Movement Media AI to evaluate campaign goals, permitted contextual signals, inventory and performance data when deciding whether an ad fits. The announcement leaves current cross-channel inventory and actual in-car signals unspecified. The company says it will continue supporting audio customers and partners.
